Hi Sophie / Raj,

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the signature — welcome aboard. Attached is our first-draft MAP that embeds the post-signature implementation plan, split into: rollout phases, guarded canary windows, migration cutover, and training / enablement. High level:

- Week 0 (7/24-7/30): Provisioning & environment smoke tests (private model variants in staging).
- Week 1 (7/31-8/6): Canary A — 1% traffic, feature-flagged; run synthetic eval suite + token-cost baseline.
- Week 2 (8/7-8/13): Canary B — 10% traffic and first customer pilot sessions (training ops).
- Week 3 (8/14-8/20): Migration window / rolling cutover (gradual ramp to 50%).
- Week 4 (8/21-8/27): Full production ramp and post-cutover hypercare.

Key asks from GaleWind to confirm in the next 48 hours:
1) Acceptance criteria for canary (latency p95 <= 220ms, failure-rate < 0.5%, quality regression < 1.5% according to eval set).
2) Two-week training slots for product and support (we recommend 8/2 and 8/9, 90 minutes each).
3) Primary contacts for cutover day and a signed runbook acknowledgement (we include the runbook as Appendix B of the MAP).

Attachments: GaleWind_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP + appendices), GaleWind_EvalChecklist_v1.xlsx, MSA_signed_GaleWind.pdf

If that schedule looks sane to you I'll set up a 30-minute alignment call tomorrow and share the canary monitoring dashboard links.

Thanks,
Logan
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Great questions — quick answers inline:

1) Eval set: we'll run the agreed "payments_edge_v2" prompt set (attached in the EvalChecklist) which includes your edge-case prompts and the golden ground-truth. We'll run both automated BLEU/ROUGE-like metrics for structured outputs and a small blinded human-quality review sample for the severity cases.

2) Migration approach: we recommend a rolling route-by-route ramp (your preference). Our runbook shows the exact traffic-shift steps and automatic fallback policy (instant revert to previous variant + circuit-breaker) — that gives us a controlled ramp and immediate rollback if needed.

3) Training: 8/3 09:30-11:00 PST works for us. We'll send calendar invites with pre-read materials.

4) Canary logs: yes, we will provide a secured export (S3 link with limited retention by default, 30 days) and an anonymized extract for your SOC review. If GaleWind requires longer retention, we can add a compliance add-on to the SOW.

Next steps: I'll update the MAP (v1.1) with the payments_edge_v2 reference, change Week 1/2 training slot to 8/3, and re-issue the runbook acknowledgement page for signature. Planning call tomorrow at 10:00am PST?

Best,
